title: Autonomous runs decide the remaining Test/Design/Build gates by rule
context: Run 20 still asked about a phone screen compared at desktop size, an override for already-decided screenshot causes, brief capabilities without a screen, and a size target against required behaviour.
decision: Per-screen viewport from the approved package; autonomous_override.py allows a screenshot-only override only on committed-ADR or brief-quoted causes with the ratio re-measured from a neutralised pair; record-non-ui-frs.py records brief-declared non-UI FRs; a size target is soft in autonomous runs.
consequences: Fewer questions in autonomous runs; interactive unchanged; the override rule couples to the screenshot metric and the accepted-causes block.
rationale: Each answer already exists in the approved package or an earlier decision; evidence is checked by code, not taken from the agent.
rejected: Prose-only override rule (agent approves itself); loosening the tolerance; asking each time; viewport from the built file or screen-routes.
